title: One supervisor run: the decision the kernel asked of a supervisor, the seat it ran in, and when its sandbox was made

number.description: The ask's number in the program, counted from 1 in the order the kernel asked.

try.description: Which run of the ask this is: 1, or 2 when the first ended with the ask unanswered.

ask.description: What the supervisor is asked to decide: which goals to start, at the program's start; or, after a failed round, what to do with one goal, which goal and round name. Goal and round are given exactly for a decide ask.

goal.description: The goal waiting in deciding, by its contract's path in the ledger.

round.description: The failed round the decision follows, numbered from 1 across the goal.

seat.description: What the supervisor ran as: the limits' fixed seat, and the image it ran in.

limits.description: The limits in force for the run, by their path in the ledger.

started.description: When the kernel asked for the supervisor's sandbox, as a UTC instant: its wall clock counts from here, so a kernel opened again charges the time already run.
